summary.root_cause_text: Config change to payment_provider_url=internal://payments-v2 (applied with v1.4 at 06:56) is unreachable, so payments silently failed while orders were marked processed. v1.4 ledger sync job (batch size tuning) corrupted ledger amounts, overstating 14 entries.
recommended: Fix the v1.4 ledger sync batch-size bug before redeploying
Validate the payments-v2 endpoint before any switch
Add alerting on DEBUG payment provider failures

I see two distinct issues here: the v1.4 ledger sync bug causing rollback, and a separate payment URL config change to v2. Since the rollback doesn't appear to affect the config change, I should prioritize fixing the data corruption first by doing the rollback, then handle the config update separately.
